profiles.name: Chan Foong Hin
profiles.position: Deputy Minister of Agriculture and Food Security
profiles.description: Chan Foong Hin represents Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Agriculture and Food Security. Affiliated with DAP.

profiles.name: Shahelmey Yahya
profiles.description: Shahelmey Yahya represents Putatan, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Parliament records affiliation with Barisan Nasional (BN). Reports of suspended UMNO membership are recorded in the profile sources.
profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament’s current BN label is retained. The UMNO suspension report is recorded; neither active UMNO membership nor a move to another party is inferred.

profiles.name: Ewon Benedick
profiles.position: Member of the Dewan Rakyat; President of UPKO
profiles.description: Ewon Benedick represents Penampang, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Member of the Dewan Rakyat; President of UPKO. Affiliated with UPKO.
profiles.affiliation_note: UPKO joined GRS on 18 June 2026. Parliament does not list a current federal cabinet portfolio for Ewon; the former federal KUSKOP portfolio is not shown as current.

milestones.title: Hold 400 Agro-Madani sales events in Sabah during 2026
milestones.description: At the first reported Sabah programme, Chan announced the annual target for fresh-produce sales events across the state’s constituencies.
milestones.progress_note: The January launch establishes activity toward the target. A later cumulative event count was not verified. The RM5 million sales target and national budget are different measures, so no completion percentage is calculated. The source’s older portfolio label is superseded by the current Parliament profile.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
